items.exampleEn: The trains in Japan are famous for being punctual.
items.exampleZh: 日本的火車以準時聞名。

items.exampleEn: Prices have doubled over the past decade.
items.exampleZh: 過去十年來，物價翻了一倍。

items.exampleEn: The museum has a large collection of contemporary art.
items.exampleZh: 這間博物館收藏大量當代藝術作品。

items.exampleEn: We will update the existing system instead of buying a new one.
items.exampleZh: 我們會更新現有的系統，而不是買新的。

items.exampleEn: I had previously met him at a conference in Tainan.
items.exampleZh: 我之前在台南的一場研討會上見過他。

items.exampleEn: The ultimate decision is up to the manager.
items.exampleZh: 最後的決定權在經理手上。

items.exampleEn: The movie was originally three hours long, but they cut it.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影原本有三小時長，但後來被剪短了。

items.exampleEn: No prior experience is needed for this job.
items.exampleZh: 這份工作不需要先前的工作經驗。

items.sentenceEn: Please arrive at least ten minutes prior to the interview.
items.sentenceZh: 請至少在面試前十分鐘抵達。

items.audioEn: The restaurant was originally a bank. It opened about a decade ago.
items.audioZh: 這家餐廳原本是一間銀行。它大約十年前開張。

items.sentenceEn: Being punctual is important when you work with clients.
items.sentenceZh: 和客戶合作時，準時很重要。

items.sentenceEn: Our existing customers will get a discount next month.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的現有顧客下個月可以享有折扣。

items.stemEn: Opening one shop is just the first step; our ____ goal is to have shops in every country.
items.stemZh: 開一家店只是第一步；我們的最終目標是在每個國家都有店。

items.stemEn: The meeting room was ____ used as a storage room.
items.stemZh: 這間會議室原本是當儲藏室用的。

items.passageEn: Our company recently moved into a building near the river. It was originally a factory, built more than eight decades ago. Prior to our move, the owner turned it into a bright office with contemporary furniture, but he kept some existing features, such as the old brick walls. Previously, our team worked in three different places, so meetings were difficult to arrange and people were seldom punctual. Now everyone works under one roof, which is undoubtedly better. The ultimate aim of the move was to help us work together more closely, and so far, it seems to be working.
items.passageZh: 我們公司最近搬進河邊的一棟大樓。它原本是一座工廠，建於八十多年前。在我們搬進去之前，屋主把它改成一間明亮的辦公室，擺上現代風格的桌椅，但保留了一些原有的特色，例如老舊的磚牆。以前，我們團隊分散在三個不同的地方工作，所以會議很難安排，大家也很少準時。現在所有人都在同一個屋簷下工作，這無疑好多了。這次搬家的最終目的是讓大家合作得更密切，到目前為止，似乎很有效。

questions.questionZh: 這棟建築原本是做什麼用的？
搬家之前，為什麼很難安排會議？
options: 大家分散在三個地方工作
舊辦公室的會議室太小
舊辦公室離大家的家都太遠

items.promptZh: 我以前在一家銀行工作了十年。
referenceEn: I previously worked at a bank for a decade.
Previously, I worked in a bank for ten years.
rubricZh: previously 可放在動詞前或句首（例如 I previously worked…、Previously, I… 等）
「十年」可寫，例如 a decade、ten years 等；過去的事用過去式

items.promptZh: 我的新同事每天都很準時，從來不遲到。
referenceEn: My new colleague is always punctual and is never late.
My new colleague is punctual every day and never arrives late.
rubricZh: punctual 當形容詞，放 be 動詞後（例如 is always punctual 等）；always 位置不扣分
「從來不遲到」可寫，例如 is never late、never arrives late、never comes in late 等
